en.description:
Fishy Watch — a fishing game built for your Apple Watch.

Use your arm to cast the line, or activate automatic mode. Dive deeper with the Digital Crown, hook curious fish by tapping, and reel them in with the Digital Crown. Every catch lives on in its respective aquarium.

FISHING
- 5 locations, 20 fish species to discover
- Control your hook depth with the Digital Crown
- Each fish has its own curiosity pattern and fight style
- Earn up to 3 stars per catch

YOUR AQUARIUM
- Feed your fish to keep them alive
- Fish grow with age — from tiny fry to full-size elder
- Pick a walk buddy: 1,000 real steps = 10 extra minutes of life
- Widgets and notifications warn you before a fish starves

MINI-GAMES
- Dance: match the puffer fish's arrow directions
- Rush: dodge incoming fish and collect time bubbles
- Deep Dive: endless descent through all 5 worlds, no stars to lose
- Calm Water: 30 calm seconds with your heart beat — +30 minutes for the whole tank

CHILL VIBES
- No ads, no in-app purchases, no data collection
- 24 languages, pixel art, satisfying haptics
- Perfect for a quick round during a commute or a slow meeting

Fishy Watch is a tiny game with a surprising amount of depth. Give it a try.
en.releaseNotes:
Calm Water: take a 30-second breather with your fish while your heart rate beats along on screen. Every fish in the tank earns +30 minutes of life - once per tank per day.

Your fish now grow: from tiny fry to full-size elder, a little bigger every day.

Plus fixes and polish.
en.subtitle: Fishing fun!

ja.description:
Fishy Watch — Apple Watchのための釣りゲーム。

腕を振ってキャスト、または自動モードをオン。Digital Crownで深く潜り、タップで好奇心旺盛な魚をフッキング、Digital Crownで巻き上げよう。釣った魚はそれぞれの水槽で暮らします。

釣り
- 5つの釣り場、発見できる20種類の魚
- Digital Crownで針の深さをコントロール
- 魚ごとに好奇心のパターンとファイトスタイルが違う
- 1匹につき最大3つ星を獲得

あなたの水槽
- エサをあげて魚を元気に保とう
- 魚は歳とともに成長 — 小さな稚魚から立派な成魚へ
- 散歩バディを選ぼう:実際の1,000歩=寿命+10分
- ウィジェットと通知が、魚が空腹で弱る前に知らせてくれる

ミニゲーム
- ダンス:フグの矢印に合わせてスワイプ
- Rush:魚をよけて時間の泡を集めよう
- Deep Dive:5つの世界を巡る終わりなき潜水、星を失う心配なし
- 穏やかな水面:心拍とともに30秒の静けさ — 水槽全体に+30分

まったりモード
- 広告なし、課金なし、データ収集なし
- 24言語対応、ピクセルアート、心地よい触覚フィードバック
- 通勤中や退屈な会議のスキマ時間にぴったり

Fishy Watchは小さなゲームだけど、驚くほど奥が深い。試してみて。
ja.releaseNotes:
穏やかな水面:魚たちと30秒のひと休み。あなたの心拍が画面上で一緒に鼓動します。水槽の魚全員に寿命+30分 - 水槽ごとに1日1回。

魚が成長するようになりました:小さな稚魚から老魚まで、毎日少しずつ大きくなります。

そのほか修正と磨き込み。

de.description:
Fishy Watch — ein Angelspiel, entwickelt fuer deine Apple Watch.

Wirf die Angel mit einer Armbewegung aus oder aktiviere den Automatikmodus. Tauche tiefer mit der Digital Crown, hake neugierige Fische per Tipp und hole sie mit der Digital Crown ein. Jeder Fang lebt in seinem eigenen Aquarium weiter.

ANGELN
- 5 Angelplaetze, 20 Fischarten zum Entdecken
- Steuere die Hakentiefe mit der Digital Crown
- Jeder Fisch hat sein eigenes Neugier-Muster und seinen eigenen Kampfstil
- Verdiene bis zu 3 Sterne pro Fang

DEIN AQUARIUM
- Fuettere deine Fische, damit sie am Leben bleiben
- Fische wachsen mit dem Alter — vom winzigen Jungfisch zum Aeltesten
- Waehle einen Spazierfisch: 1.000 echte Schritte = 10 Extra-Minuten Leben
- Widgets und Mitteilungen warnen dich, bevor ein Fisch verhungert

MINISPIELE
- Tanz: Triff die Pfeilrichtungen des Kugelfischs
- Rush: Weiche Fischen aus und sammle Zeitblasen
- Deep Dive: endloser Tauchgang durch alle 5 Welten, keine Sterne zu verlieren
- Ruhiges Wasser: 30 ruhige Sekunden mit deinem Herzschlag — +30 Minuten fuers ganze Aquarium

ENTSPANNTE VIBES
- Keine Werbung, keine In-App-Kaeufe, keine Datensammlung
- 24 Sprachen, Pixel-Art, angenehme Haptik
- Perfekt fuer eine schnelle Runde beim Pendeln oder im langweiligen Meeting

Fishy Watch ist ein kleines Spiel mit ueberraschend viel Tiefgang. Probier's aus.
de.releaseNotes:
Ruhiges Wasser: Goenn dir eine 30-Sekunden-Pause mit deinen Fischen, waehrend deine Herzfrequenz auf dem Bildschirm mitschlaegt. Jeder Fisch im Aquarium erhaelt +30 Minuten Leben - einmal pro Aquarium und Tag.

Deine Fische wachsen jetzt: vom winzigen Jungfisch zum ausgewachsenen Aeltesten, jeden Tag ein Stueck groesser.

Dazu Fixes und Feinschliff.

New in v1.2:

Deep Dive — a new endless fishing mode. Descend through all 5 worlds top to bottom, with the hook resetting after every catch or escape so you keep diving. Pure fishing, no stars. A new stats screen tracks sessions, catches, losses, and your best streak.

Tank Action Menu — swipe up in the aquarium for quick access to Crabs, Dance, and Rush. Pick your fish for Rush directly from the menu.

Fishing feel — smoothed fight timing across the game so strong pulls feel more readable and fair.

Haptic feedback — bite confirmation when you hook a fish, vibrations on direction changes during the fight, and satisfying taps on win or loss. All respects the Sound toggle in Settings.

Stability — fixed 40+ potential crash points, safer image loading, better memory handling throughout the app.

watchOS 26 ready — toolbar rendering fixed on the latest watchOS.

Plus cleaner code, removed dead weight, and a smoother experience overall.

Fishing scenes refreshed — sandy floor, naturally placed plants, no more dark gap at the bottom.

Deep Dive polish — wider pull area, lost fish return to the sea, new repeat button resets the school. Resuming after surfacing and fish orientation after re-hooking now work correctly.

Now properly available in all 24 supported languages on the App Store.

Fishing mode fix — after a catch or surfacing, pressing Start now properly restarts the round with a fresh prescreen.

Deep Dive — a lost fish now swims back to its original depth instead of lingering where it escaped, and the hook gets a short cooldown after a lost fight so a passing fish can't accidentally re-hook you.

Info screen now always shows the current app version automatically.
